title: Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes: Booking-Count Scale on the Companion Fare Cancellation Retention
content:
The cancellation retention kept from a companion fare refund on a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes product is scaled by how often the certificate has been booked, counting every companion booking entry in the trip and charge history of the certificate or pass — every booking on it, whether flown, open or later cancelled.

| Companion booking entries on the certificate or pass | Scale applied to the cancellation retention |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | multiplied by 1.25 |
| exactly 2 | multiplied by 1.1 |
| 1 | left unscaled |

## Notes to the scale

- The count covers the whole history of the certificate or pass, not a period.
- A booking that was later cancelled and reinstated still counts as a booking entry.

**Hypothetical cases.** A pass carrying five booking entries multiplies a retention of 40.00 USD by 1.25, giving 50.00 USD; a certificate carrying two booking entries multiplies it by 1.1, giving 44.00 USD; a certificate booked once leaves 40.00 USD as it is.
